question: Can one App resolve a review thread opened by another App or by a third-party reviewer?
pass: Written 2026-10-22T18:07:40Z, before the window: the pr-review App resolves a thread by the trial-author App, one by CodeRabbit and one by a person; each reads back resolved by the pr-review App. Asked on canary pull request 62, opened by the Maintainer since CodeRabbit reviews no pull request a bot opened: CodeRabbit's thread from its own review, a person's thread, and the trial-author App's. The pr-review App, with every permission it holds, was refused all three; the trial-author App, narrowed to pull_requests: write, was refused the two others opened, and with contents: write beside it resolved both, read back resolved by it. Failed as written: an App resolves another's thread only with contents: write.
